title: Intracranial EEG Epilepsy - Studies 3, 5 and 6 (Mayo Clinic; IEEG.org)
description: Long-term clinical intracranial EEG recordings from three patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, collected at Mayo Clinic (Rochester, MN) and originally shared through IEEG.org and Pennsieve Discover (Studies 3, 5 and 6). Recordings use subdural grid/strip and depth electrodes and include expert seizure annotations. The data were converted losslessly from MEF 2.0 to BIDS iEEG in BrainVision format, with each run corresponding to a continuous segment.
methods_description: Clinical intracranial EEG was recorded with an XLTek EEG 128 system at 500 Hz. MEF 2.0 files were decoded with mef_lib_2_1 and split into runs at MEF discontinuities. They were written as BrainVision INT_32, with every sample verified against the decoded MEF. Seizure annotations from the IEEG.org layer were converted to events.tsv.
